verdict.rationale: The evidence shows autonomous AI agents for screening and transaction monitoring that auto-remediate alerts and escalate cases. It also shows agent-readable documentation (llms.txt, markdown docs) and an OpenAPI schema. None of this documents a way for a user to operate ComplyAdvantage through natural-language commands, such as a chat or copilot interface or an NL query layer. These are adjacent features and developer building blocks, so they earn no credit toward this story.
